sloka: अशोक वनिका मध्ये मैथिली नीयताम् इति ।तत्र इयम् रक्ष्यताम् गूढम् युष्माभिः परिवारिता ॥३-५६-३०॥
transliteration: aśoka vanikā madhye maithilī nīyatām iti ।tatra iyam rakṣyatām gūḍham yuṣmābhiḥ parivāritā ॥3-56-30॥

translations.english: Let this Sita be led into the Asoka grove. There sit round her and protect her in secret (her presence there should not be made public).
